# Tardiness constraints

# Sequencing constraints
for i in job_ids:
    for j in job_ids:
        if i != j:
            model.addConstr(C[i] + jobs[j]["processing_time"] <= C[j] + (1 - x[i, j]) * sum(jobs[k]["processing_time"] for k in job_ids), name=f"seq_{i}_{j}")

    model.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for i in job_ids if i != j) == 1, name=f"one_predecessor_{j}")
    model.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[j, i] for i in job_ids if i != j) == 1, name=f"one_successor_{j}")

# Optimize the model
model.optimize()

# Extract the sequence
sequence = []
for i in job_ids:
    for j in job_ids:
        if i != j and x[i, j].X > 0.5:
            sequence.append((i, j))

# Reconstruct the job sequence
job_sequence = []
current_job = next(j for j in job_ids if sum(x[i, j].X for i in job_ids if i != j) == 0)
while len(job_sequence) < n:
    job_sequence.append(current_job)
    current_job = next(j for j in job_ids if x[current_job, j].X > 0.5)

# Output the result
objective_value = model.ObjVal
result = {"sequence": job_sequence, "objective_value": objective_value}
print(result)

model = gp.Model("single_machine_scheduling")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0
model.Params.TimeLimit = 30  # Reduce the time limit for the solver

# Sets and parameters
job_ids = list(jobs.keys())
n = len(job_ids)

# Variables
C = model.addVars(job_ids, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="C")  # Completion times
T = model.addVars(job_ids, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="T")  # Tardiness
x = model.addVars(job_ids, job_ids, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="x")  # Sequencing variables

# Objective: Minimize the total weighted tardiness
model.setObjective(gp.quicksum(jobs[j]["weight"] * T[j] for j in job_ids), GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Constraints
# Completion time constraints
for j in job_ids:
    model.addConstr(C[j] >= jobs[j]["processing_time"], name=f"completion_time_{j}")

# Tardiness constraints
for j in job_ids:
    model.addConstr(T[j] >= C[j] - jobs[j]["due_date"], name=f"tardiness_{j}")

# Sequencing constraints
M = sum(jobs[j]["processing_time"] for j in job_ids)  # Big M
for i in job_ids:
    for j in job_ids:
        if i != j:
            model.addConstr(C[i] + jobs[j]["processing_time"] <= C[j] + M * (1 - x[i, j]), name=f"seq_{i}_{j}")

# Each job must be scheduled exactly once
for j in job_ids:
    model.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for i in job_ids if i != j) == 1, name=f"one_predecessor_{j}")
    model.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[j, i] for i in job_ids if i != j) == 1, name=f"one_successor_{j}")

# Optimize the model
model.optimize()

job_sequence = []
if model.status == GRB.OPTIMAL or model.status == GRB.TIME_LIMIT:
    current_job = next(j for j in job_ids if sum(x[i, j].X for i in job_ids if i != j) == 0)
    while len(job_sequence) < n:

        current_job = next((j for j in job_ids if x[current_job, j].X > 0.5), None)
        if current_job is None:
            break

objective_value = model.ObjVal if model.status == GRB.OPTIMAL or model.status == GRB.TIME_LIMIT else None
